newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mostly higher.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mostly higher Wednesday in line with the bullion market after support was again found in gold just below $340 an ounce this week.

Renewed concerns about central bank gold sales and renewed shorting by funds drove gold down Monday to test the four year lows seen in January just below $340 an ounce, but better than expected U.S. data on wage inflation Tuesday, helped U.S. treasury bonds rally sharply, taking some of the pressure off precious metals which are not interest bearing assets.
